text: it was surprising thst it broke so easily. We notified the manufacturor as we had registered .... While slicing an onion, the knive broke a chip in the prime cutting area of the product. As I'm very skilled in using "serious"  kitchen utensils, it was surprising thst it broke so easily. We notified the manufacturor as we had registered the products. They promptly replaced the product
